controls.label: Turns
controls.serializedMeaning: Sets the integer angular revolutions along one longitudinal path.
controls.causalObservation: At fixed source, canvas, and time, every card's angle/depth and the number of front/rear crossings change while source order and endpoint seam remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Turn count defines the Scene topology and cannot be derived from Timeline or Look.

controls.label: Radial spread
controls.serializedMeaning: Scales horizontal helix radius before canvas recomposition.
controls.causalObservation: At fixed time, x positions change while `u`, y pitch, source order, and depth phase stay unchanged.
controls.ownershipReason: Radial geometry is intrinsic to the helix.

controls.label: Depth pitch
controls.serializedMeaning: Sets longitudinal separation and total offstage endpoint span per turn.
controls.causalObservation: At fixed time, y positions and inter-turn separation change while x radius and angular depth remain unchanged.
controls.ownershipReason: Pitch distinguishes a 3D helix from a flat spiral.

controls.label: Card size
controls.serializedMeaning: Sets natural-ratio card height before portrait wide-card reduction.
controls.causalObservation: Card width/height change proportionally while path coordinate and crossing order remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Source scale affects path legibility and collision bounds.

controls.label: Direction
controls.serializedMeaning: Changes the sign of path traversal without reordering media or changing the helix.
controls.causalObservation: At fixed story time, path phase becomes its modular inverse and every source traverses the same path backwards.
controls.ownershipReason: Production integration must map the authoritative portable Timeline direction into this Scene field without creating duplicate state.

rejectedControls.reason: Seam is hidden geometrically; source opacity must stay faithful.
Introduces a singularity and flat spiral behaviour.
Look/post-processing cannot be required for Scene topology.
